title: tests/dbspec/plan-cases.json
description: The plan cases file: its version, its note and the requirement ids (docs/spec) that the plan cases test. The cases are the recipe in this file, their database data is plans-physical.json, and the validation sections are the recipes beside this file.

requirements.description: The requirement ids of docs/spec that the cases of this file test, read by no runner.

cases.description: The cases, each a recipe case (scripts/features/schema/recipe.schema.json); the recipe reader checks each one.
